ModelAcceleration.description:
The model catalog owns how the product's acceleration preference changes a call.
A speed parameter and a different model ID must never be recorded as service tiers.

fastMode.description: Whether acceleration is supported; settings.acceleration declares the request mechanism.

imageDetailOriginal.description: Whether original-detail image requests are supported; image input is declared separately.

ModelInstructions.description: Complete base instructions owned by one model entry, independently editable and versioned.

body.description: Complete model-specific Agent instructions; runtime permission and project instructions are separate.

revision.description: Version of this complete base prompt, frozen with its body when a Turn is accepted.

ModelReasoningEffortOption.description:
A selectable effort and its catalog explanation. Missing copy is unknown metadata;
the effort remains a request value and never implies a fixed token budget.

ModelServiceTier.description: A provider service tier ID is a request value; its label and explanation are display metadata.

acceleration.description: How the acceleration preference changes a request: tier, speed parameter, or exact model ID.

defaultReasoningSummary.description: Ash's summary default; the string "none" suppresses summaries without disabling reasoning.

defaultServiceTier.description: Ash's request default referencing a declared serviceTiers ID.

defaultVerbosity.description: Ash's request default; requires verbosity=true. This is not an inferred provider default.

inputModalities.description: Declared input kinds; a declared list must include text. Omission means unknown.

reasoningSummary.description: Support for returning reasoning summaries, separate from effort and replayable reasoning history.

serviceTiers.description: Exact provider tier IDs with display names and explanations; these do not grant account access.

toolOutputLimit.description: Core's tool-result truncation budget; not a provider inference parameter or output-token limit.

verbosity.description: Support for a verbosity request parameter: true supported, false unsupported, null or omission unknown.

ModelSpeed.description: Inference speed is independent of provider scheduling and billing service tiers.

ModelToolOutputLimit.description:
Limits model-visible tool text; original durable tool results remain intact.
Token limits use the shared output utility's UTF-8 byte approximation, not token measurement.

StaticModelSpec.description: One row in Ash's bundled JSON model catalog, independent of account access.

auto_compact_token_limit.description: Optional model-specific compaction threshold, constrained by the effective execution budget.

capabilities.description: Confirmed model capabilities; omitted members and null mean unknown, not false.

context_window.description: Declared model capacity in tokens; null or omission means unknown, not unlimited.

context_window_options.description:
One or two ascending execution budgets within capacity; the first is Ash's default.
Omission uses declared capacity. These budgets do not change the model's capacity.

model_id.description: Exact catalog model ID; connection-specific upstream aliases are configured separately.

model_reasoning_effort.description: Ash's default effort; when present it must reference a declared selectable value.

provider_id.description: Exact model vendor ID, independent of API-key or subscription connection identity.

settings.description: Parameter support, Ash defaults, acceleration mechanism, and model-visible tool-result budget.

supported_reasoning_efforts.description: Selectable effort values and their display explanations, independent of a fixed token budget.
